description: This file defines the ResourceEndpoint interface in PHP for the OrangeHRM system. It specifies methods for CRUD operations and their validation rules for API endpoints related to resources.

classes.name: ResourceEndpoint
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for resource API endpoints with methods for retrieval, update, deletion, and validation rules, including associated exceptions.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieve a single resource; throws relevant exceptions if operation fails.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne operation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Update a resource; throws relevant exceptions if operation fails.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update operation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete a resource; throws relevant exceptions if operation fails.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete operation.
